summary: Whirlpool Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a First Supplemental Indenture entered into by its Luxembourg finance subsidiary, the issuer, to amend the indenture governing its 1.100% Notes due 2027. The amendment, approved via consents solicited in a concurrent tender offer, reduces the satisfaction-and-discharge waiting period from one year to two years. As of June 12, 2026, approximately 91.12% of the €600M notes ($546.7M aggregate) had been tendered. The change facilitates earlier defeasance of the notes once all tendered notes are purchased. No premium, consideration type, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a bond indenture amendment rather than a classic special situation. Watch for completion of the tender settlement.
